import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int N, M;
    static long[][] P = new long[10][10];
    static long[] dp1 = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] dp2 = new long[1 << 20];
    static int[] idx1 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] idx2 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] corr = new int[25];

    static long modPow(long b, long e) {
        long r = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r * b % MOD;
            b = b * b % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static void enumerate1(int cur, List<Integer> curVec, long probVal) {
        if (cur == M) {
            int mask = 0, cnt = 0;
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(s) != M) continue;
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
                    if (((s >> i) & 1) == 1) v.add(i);
                Collections.sort(v);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j)
                        if (((curVec.get(j) >> v.get(j)) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
                if (found) mask |= 1 << cnt;
                ++cnt;
            }
            dp1[mask] = (dp1[mask] + probVal) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
            curVec.add(s);
            long newProb = probVal;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (((s >> j) & 1) == 1)
                    newProb = newProb * P[cur][j] % MOD;
                else
                    newProb = newProb * (MOD + 1 - P[cur][j]) % MOD;
            }
            enumerate1(cur + 1, curVec, newProb);
            curVec.remove(curVec.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(arr, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(arr.subList(i + 1, arr.size()));
        return true;
    }

    static void enumerate2(int cur, List<Integer> curVec, long probVal) {
        if (cur == N) {
            int mask = 0, cnt = 0;
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(s) != N - M) continue;
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
                    if (((s >> i) & 1) == 1) v.add(i);
                Collections.sort(v);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < N - M; ++j)
                        if (((curVec.get(j) >> v.get(j)) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
                if (found) mask |= 1 << cnt;
                ++cnt;
            }
            dp2[mask] = (dp2[mask] + probVal) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
            curVec.add(s);
            long newProb = probVal;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (((s >> j) & 1) == 1)
                    newProb = newProb * P[cur][j] % MOD;
                else
                    newProb = newProb * (MOD + 1 - P[cur][j]) % MOD;
            }
            enumerate2(cur + 1, curVec, newProb);
            curVec.remove(curVec.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                P[i][j] = 1L * x * modPow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                if (P[i][j] < 0) P[i][j] += MOD;
            }
        }

        if (N == 1) {
            System.out.println(P[0][0]);
            return;
        }

        M = N / 2;
        List<Integer> cur = new ArrayList<>();
        enumerate1(0, cur, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) dp1[i] %= MOD;

        for (int b = 0; b < 20; ++b)
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << 20); ++s)
                if (((s >> b) & 1) == 1)
                    dp1[s] = (dp1[s] + dp1[s ^ (1 << b)]) % MOD;

        long total = dp1[(1 << 20) - 1];

        cur.clear();
        enumerate2(M, cur, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) dp2[i] %= MOD;

        Arrays.fill(idx1, -1);
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(s) != M) continue;
            idx1[s] = cnt++;
        }

        Arrays.fill(idx2, -1);
        cnt = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << N); ++s) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(s) != N - M) continue;
            corr[cnt] = idx1[((1 << N) - 1) ^ s];
            idx2[s] = cnt++;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << cnt); ++s) {
            long val = dp2[s];
            int mask = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < cnt; ++b) {
                if (((s >> b) & 1) == 1) continue;
                mask |= 1 << corr[b];
            }
            ans = (ans + val * ((total - dp1[mask] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(ans % MOD);
    }
}
